messages:
Alex: Heads-up — deploying small rate-card tagging change tonight (v2026.04.1).
Maya: TL;DR on what to do?
Alex: New tag field: ratecard_tag:special_terms=<reason>. set in quote metadata or commit creation.
Julian: Example?
Alex: e.g. `ratecard_tag:special_terms=legacy-credit-map`
Priya: will the portal show it?
Alex: Not in UI right away. API/CSV/imports/CLI first. Portal patch next sprint.
Maya: How does Deal Desk see it?
DealDeskBot: Incoming tagged deals now create a ticket in #deal-desk-queue and attach the tag. :robot_face:
Julian: Does this auto-approve anything?
LegalOps: No automatic approvals. Tags only improve routing and visibility; workflow rules still apply.
Priya: Any constraints on tag content?
Alex: 64 chars max; allowed chars: letters, numbers, hyphen, underscore. Keep it short.
Maya: For grandfathered POCs we should have a canonical `grandfather` reason?
Alex: Yes — use `grandfather` or `grandfather:<legacy-id>` for mapping. Ops will publish mapping table.
Julian: Reporting?
Alex: CSV exports include `ratecard_tag` column; BI will ingest for dashboards.
Priya: Timeline?
Alex: Sandbox deploy tonight at 22:00 UTC; prod 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Docs + AE snippet after prod verify.
Maya: Can we show a small reminder in quoting flow?
Alex: Filed FE ticket PO-472.
DealDeskBot: Reminder: urgent blockers still escalate to @LegalOps and @SalesLeads even if tagged.
Maya: I'll update the POC checklist and blast AEs.
Alex: I'll post a follow-up doc in #sales-docs post-prod. Ping me if routing looks off.
Julian: Closing loop from my side.
Alex: Closing thread.
